words.ex: Please inform us of any changes.
use: I'll inform you when it's ready.
We were informed of the schedule change.
mcq: I informed the news to her.
I informed her of the news.
I informed to her the news.
I informed about her the news.
words.note: inform + 사람 + of + 내용. 사람이 먼저!

words.ex: Let me examine the details first.
words.note: examine + 대상 바로 연결.

words.ex: Find a partner for this activity.
use: We partnered with a local company.
mcq: We partnered with them last year.
We partnered to them last year.
words.note: partner with = ~와 제휴하다. 동사로도 쓴다는 게 포인트!

words.ex: Don't be afraid of making mistakes.
use: I made a mistake in the report.
words.note: make a mistake! do가 아니라 make — 최고 빈출 짝(collocation)이에요.

words.ex: There's a schedule conflict on Friday.
use: The meeting conflicts with my class.
mcq: The two meetings conflict with each other.
The two meetings conflict to each other.
words.note: conflict with = ~와 겹치다/충돌하다. 일정 얘기할 때 아주 유용!

words.ex: Does your insurance cover this?
use: I need travel insurance for the trip.
mcq: I bought one insurance of travel.
words.note: insurance는 셀 수 없는 명사! a를 붙이지 않아요.

words.ex: She works in finance.
mcq: The bank financed the new building.
The bank financed to the building.
The bank made finance the building.
words.note: finance는 동사로 '자금을 대다'로도 써요.

words.ex: She answered with confidence.
use: He has confidence in his team.
mcq: I have confidence in my English now.
I have confidence to my English.
I have confident in my English.
words.note: confidence(명사) in + 대상. confident는 형용사!

words.ex: Put your devices away during dinner.
words.exko: 저녁 먹을 땐 기기 좀 치워요.
use: Charge your device before the flight.
mcq: My device is running out of battery.
My device is running out battery.
My device runs out of the battery now going.
My device battery is run out going.
words.note: run out of battery = 배터리가 다 되어가다.

words.ex: I can't concentrate with this noise.
words.exko: 이 소음 때문에 집중이 안 돼요.
use: Let's concentrate on the main issue.
She concentrated hard on the test.
words.note: concentrate on! focus on과 같은 전치사예요.

words.ex: I'll definitely be there!
use: This is definitely the best option.
mcq: I will definitely to call you.
I will call definitely be you.
words.note: definitely는 조동사와 본동사 사이! 대답 한마디로도 자주 써요.

words.ex: I trust your judgment.
use: In my judgment, we should wait.
words.note: use one's judgment = 알아서 판단하다. 업무에서 아주 자주 쓰는 표현!

words.ex: Enjoy the journey, not just the destination.
use: The train journey takes three hours.
My English journey started last year.
mcq: How did you journey the trip?
words.note: journey는 긴 이동·과정. trip과 겹쳐 쓰지 않아요.

words.ex: Be careful with that glass.
use: She's very careful about spending money.
mcq: Be careful of the wet floor.
words.note: be careful of/with + 대상. carefully는 부사!

words.ex: She rejected my suggestion.
use: The idea was rejected by the team.
words.note: reject + 대상 바로 연결.

words.ex: Excuse me, can I ask you something?
use: Stop making excuses and just do it.
That's no excuse for being late.
mcq: He made an excuse for being late.
He did an excuse for being late.
He took an excuse for late.
He got excuse to being late.
words.note: make an excuse = 변명하다. mistake처럼 make와 짝!

words.ex: Stay calm and think clearly.
use: The sea was calm this morning.
Take a deep breath and calm down.
mcq: Please calm down, everything is fine.
words.note: calm down 그 자체로 '진정하다'. be calm down처럼 섞지 않기!

words.ex: I got a small gift for you.
use: She has a gift for languages.
This watch was a gift from my father.
mcq: He has a gift for music.
He has a gift of doing music at.
He is a gift for music.
words.note: have a gift for = ~에 재능이 있다. '선물' 말고 이 뜻도 기억!

words.ex: The wind is blowing hard today.
use: Losing the deal was a big blow to us.
그 계약을 놓친 건 우리에게 큰 타격이었다.
mcq: The news was a big blow to him.
The news was a big blow at him.
The news blew him a big.
The news was blowing big him.
words.note: a blow to + 대상 = ~에게 타격. 명사 blow도 자주 써요.

words.ex: She's studying abroad in Canada.
mcq: I want to work in abroad.
I want to work to abroad.
I want to work at the abroad.
words.note: abroad 앞에 전치사 금지! 그 자체가 '해외로/에서'예요.
